title: SF AI Summit 2026 - travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Goal: consolidate flight/hotel/ground logistics, expense reminders, vendor contacts, and receipts checklist for SF AI Summit (Mar 16-18, 2026).

High-level schedule (conference):
- Mar 15 (eve): Arrival, check-in, quick sync w/ Jordan (dinner?)
- Mar 16: Summit day 1 (booth + talks)
- Mar 17: Summit day 2 (meetings + product demo)
- Mar 18: Half day, fly late evening or Mar 19 morning depending on meetings

Travel bookings (personal record):
- Flight (booked): UA 1823, SFO -> non-stop, depart Mar 15 18:45, confirm e-ticket + mobile boarding pass. PNR: HZ4R9P (save screenshot).
- Return: UA 1890, SFO -> non-stop, depart Mar 19 19:10. PNR: HZ4R9P-RET (double-check).
- Hotel (booked): The Meridian Hotel, downtown SFO. Confirmation # 554321. Check-in Mar 15, check-out Mar 19. Invoice to company - must request itemized folio at checkout.
- Ground: SF AtoB shuttle recommended for airport -> hotel (cost approx $35 each way). Uber estimates: $30-45 depending on surge.

Expense notes / reimbursements:
- Per company policy: use Expensify for receipt uploads within 7 days. Tag expenses with project code: TRV-2026-SF (expense policy doc linked above).
- Meals: per diem $75/day - keep itemized receipts for anything > $25.
- Transportation: save all ride receipts (Uber/LYFT/email receipts ok).
- Hotel: request itemized invoice. If incidentals charged to personal, note them separately and self-pay.
- Flights: attach e-ticket + seat upgrade receipts (if any).
- Booth/Promo vendors: invoice to Redwood AP (see vendor contacts below). If vendor asks for PO, route to ops-purchasing@redwood.com with copy to me.

Quick TODOs before travel:
- [ ] Upload flight + hotel confirmation to Expensify (Maya) — due Mar 1
- [ ] Request company chargeback PO for booth furniture (assigned to Sofia) — JIRA: TRAVEL-212
- [ ] Print or download digital business cards for demos (Jordan)
- [ ] Confirm demo laptop image is uploaded to booth machine (ops)
- [ ] Slack shout in #events with final headcount and timeslot for team photos

Receipts & scanning notes (workflow):
- Use Expensify app to scan receipts immediately.
- For paper receipts longer than 2in, photograph flat and add short note (what, who, business purpose).
- Group receipts by day in the Expensify report named "SF AI Summit 2026 - Maya Chen". Add approver: Renee Kline.
- Tip policy: include tips on receipt if possible. If tip not on receipt, add manual line item and note reason.

Vendor / contact list (important contacts to have on phone):
- Booth furniture / install: Pacific Expo Services — main: (415) 555-0184, ops@pacific-expo.com. Contact: Marco Ruiz
- Promo swag (stickers + shirts): BayPrint Co. — orders@bayprint.co, acct mgr: Lili Tran
- Hotel events / AV: Meridian Events Desk — events@themeridian.com, ext 402
- Shuttle / local logistics: SF Shuttle Express — dispatch@sfshuttle.com, (415) 555-0921
- Redwood AP (invoices/POs): ops-purchasing@redwood.com

Notes on vendor invoicing: ask vendors to send PDF invoices addressed to:
Redwood Inference
Attn: Accounts Payable
PO: TRV-2026-SF
Send to: ap-invoices@redwood.com and cc ops-purchasing@redwood.com

Conference-specific items to remember:
- Bring dongles: HDMI + USB-C -> HDMI, USB-C power brick, spare USB-C cable.
- Demo laptop: ensure local model image is latest (v2.3.1) and has offline fallback snippets.
- Booth kit: spare business cards, QR code printouts linking to quickstart, extra HDMI cables, power strip, tool kit (scissors + gaffer tape).
- Printed signage: 2x 24x36 posters (order placed — pickup at warehouse 3/14).

Unresolved/questions:
- Do we have a company-branded travel card for on-site purchases? (asked finance 2026-02-09, pending)
- Confirm whether Meridian offers invoice direct to company for room charges (avoids personal card).
- Should we pre-buy promo swag shipping insurance? Cost estimate needed from BayPrint — Sofia following up.

Post-trip follow-up (reimbursements & notes):
- Create final Expensify report within 7 days of return. Label: "SF AI Summit 2026 - Maya Chen".
- Upload itemized folio from hotel and booth vendor invoice.
- Submit separate expense for client entertainment if applicable (include attendee names + business reason).
- Quick trip retro (2 slides) for internal events team: what worked, what to fix (deliver to #events).

Notes-to-self (quick):
- Keep all boarding passes until reimbursement finalized.
- If phone dies, use hotel business center to email receipts to self.
- Save all Slack convo links with vendors (put in this doc after trip).

Recent changes since last sync:
- Booth furniture PO moved from contracting to pending install (Marco confirmed 3/14 install window).
- Added Jordan as backup approver for petty expenses.

End.
